column3: Retains seed and the collective singular sojourner.
Retains the purpose clauses to defile and to profane.
Retains and between father and mother in both clauses.
Retains each person seeing the other’s nakedness and the eyes of the sons of their people.
Retains the image of the fountain.
Retains the change from second-person address to he has made bare.
Retains and do them after the statutes and judgments.
Retains the separate contrasts of clean animal with unclean and unclean bird with clean, and making your souls detestable.
